title: Dribble Knockout 1v1
description: Every player dribbles inside a confined space while trying to knock away everyone else's ball and protect their own — the last ball bouncing wins.

content.objective: Protect your own dribble while trying to knock other players' balls away, under real pressure.
content.setup: Everyone dribbles freely inside the three-point line, one ball each.
instructions: On the whistle, every player dribbles and tries to slap away an opponent's ball without using two hands on their own.
A player whose ball goes out of the space or stops bouncing is out.
The space shrinks every minute by moving the boundary in.
Last player still dribbling wins the round; reset and go again.
coachingPoints: Keep the body between the ball and other players.
Use the off-hand to shield, not to swat wildly.
Keep the head up to see where other balls are coming from.
commonMistakes: Chasing other balls and losing your own.
Bunching in the middle instead of using the whole space.
Speeding up until control breaks down, instead of building speed gradually.
content.safety: No full-arm swipes at another player's hands — slap at the ball only.
